description.value:
You rally your pawns into an all-out attack, assaulting any foe caught in their path. Each target Strides up to its Speed in a straight line (or Burrows, Climbs, Flies, or Swims), and the targets' paths can't meet or cross. If a target's movement would enter an enemy's space, the target stops before entering that space and makes a melee Strike of its choice against that enemy. A single creature can't be attacked more than once by this action. Apply your multiple attack penalty normally, though you can choose the order in which your pawns attack.

Targets any number of Controlled pawns
